page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s2 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated graphics processing units, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that the virtual cores are not shared with other tenants, providing predictable compute performance for workloads that do not require specialized hardware accelerators or high-density memory configurations.
Given its balanced resource allocation, the ecs.s2.xlarge is suitable for entry-level workloads, lightweight web serving, small databases, and general-purpose development or testing environments.
